m: अप-कार m. wrong, offence, injury, hurt

VI. 1. 142) अपास्किरते वृषो हृष्टः, कुक्कुटो भक्षार्थी, श्वा आश्रयार्थी च Sk; शृंगैरपस्कीर्णमहत्तटीभुवां Śi. 12. 74 scratched; छायापस्किरमाणविष्किर &c. U. 2. 9.
अपकौशली — News, information.

a: अपकरणं — 1 Acting improperly. --2 Doing wrong, injuring; ill-treating, offending.

m: अप-कर्मन् n. discharge (of a debt), Mn. viii, 4
any impure or degrading act, L.
a: अपकर्मन् — a. [बहु. स.] Of bad or degraded actions, corrupted, depraved. --n. (˚र्म) 1 Discharge, paying off (of a debt); दत्तस्यानपकर्म च Ms. 8. 4. --2 An improper or unworthy act; evil doing, conduct, or course, any degrading or impure act. --3 Wickedness, violence, oppression. --4 Incompetence, laziness.

apakarza

pu॰ apa + kfza--BAve GaY । ucitaDarmmApekzAto hInatAyAM, “tatra pfTivyAdInAmanyonyAnupraveSakftaH salilaBavaraso'tyutkarzApakarzeRa ceti” yaTA hi varRAnAM paYcAnAmutkarzApakarzakftena saMyogaviSezeReti” ca suSrutaH “utkarzaYcApakarzaYja manuzyezviha janmata iti” manuH । “utkarzApakarzavihInomaDyaH si॰ kO॰ । svakarttavyakAlAt pUrvvakAlakaraRe, parasUtrapadAnAmanvayArTaM pUrvvasUtre AkarzaRe AkarzaRamAtre ca । apakfzyate karmmaRi GaY । svakAlataH pUrvvaM karttavye yaTA apakarzasasiRqanam । taTA ca “muKyaM SrAdDaM mAsimAsi aparyyAptAvftuM prati । dvAdaSAhena vA kuryyAdekAhe dvAdaSATaveti” smftO maraRottaraM mftAhe mAsi mAsi karttavyAnAM mfhAhanimittakamAsikAdInAM dvAdaSAhezu ekAhezu ca karttavyatvokteH sarvvApakarzaH । taTA'pakarze ca hetava ekaputratvAdayaH । “AnantyAt kulaDarmmARAM putrasya cAyuzaH kzayAt । asTiteSca SarIrasya dvAdaSAhe praSasyate iti” smftyuktAH । tatra pAScAttyAnAM kulaDarmmAt dvAdaSAha eva karttavyatAyAH kulaparamparAcAraH । vaNgIyAnAntu ekaputrasyEva AyuzaHkzayasamBAvanAyAmiti BedaH । ayameva sarvApakarzaH, AvaSyakavfdDyAramBakAle tu na sarvApakarzaH । kintu paScAdBAvinAmevApakarza iti BedaH । evaM navamamAsAdizvapyapakarzaRe na sarvAprakarza iti boDyam ।
m: अप-कर्ष m. drawing or dragging off or down, detraction, diminution, decay
(in poetry) anticipation of a word occurring later.
a: अपकर्षः — 1 (a) Drawing off or down; diminution, decrease, reduction; मेदोऽपकर्षात् Dk. 160; loss, decay, decline, destruction; तेजोपकर्षः Ve. 1; deterioration, inferiority; उत्कर्षापकर्षविहीनो मध्यः Sk. (b) Dishonour, degradation, lowering (of esteem), infamy, disgrace (opp. उत्कर्ष in all senses); तपोबीजप्रभावैस्तु ते गच्छंति युगे युगे . उत्कर्षं चापकर्षं च मनुष्येष्विह जन्मतः .. Ms. 10. 42; मूल्योत्कर्ष˚ rise and fall in price, increase and decrease. --2 Anticipated performance of a duty, as of a Śrāddha. --3 Anticipation of a word occurring later on (in gram., poetry or Mīmāṃsā &c.). --Comp. --समः a sort of fallacy; e. g. sound has not the quality of shape, as a jar, so sound and a jar have no qualities in common.

Taking or drawing away, removing, diminishing (opp. वर्धक); न चास्ति सदृशं तेन किंचित्स्थौल्यापकर्षणं Suśr. --णं 1 Removing, taking away; drawing away or down, depriving (one) of, drawing out, extracting. --2 Lessening, making inferior, detraction. --3 Superseding. --4 Denying; abolishing.

m: अप-कर्ष—सम mf(आ) a sophism in the Nyāya (e.g. ‘sound has not the quality of shape as a jar has, therefore sound and a jar have no qualities in common’).

a: अपकृ — {c8c} U. 1 To carry or bear away, remove, drag away, insult by dragging away; योऽपचक्रे वनात्सीतां Bk. 8. 20 bore forcibly away. --2 To hurt, injure, wrong, harm, do harm or injury to (usually with gen. of person); आपदि येनापकृतं Pt. 4. 16; Śi. 14. 78; न किंचिन्मया तस्यापकर्तुं शक्यं Pt. 1; किं तस्या मयापकृतं {4} what harm have I done to her? किं च राक्षसराजस्य रामेणापकृतं पुरा Rām.; sometimes with acc. or loc. also; अथ वा सौनिकाः केचिदपकुर्युर्युधिष्ठिरं Mb.; किमिव बत नाप्यन्यपकृतं Bh. 3. 115; न परेषु महौजसश्छलादपकुर्वंति मलिम्लुचा इव Śi. 16. 52. --Caus. To harm, injure &c.

m: अप-कृत् mfn. doing harm or injury, Mcar.
अप-√ 2. कृत् cl. 6. P. -कृन्तति, to cut off, Kauś.

a: अपकृत — p. p. 1 Injured, wronged, wickedly or maliciously committed &c. --2 Done or practised as a degrading or impure act, as funeral rites. --तं An injury, harm, offence.

अप-√ कृष् cl. 1. P. -कर्षति, to draw off or aside, drag down, carry away, take away, remove; to omit, diminish; to put away; to anticipate a word &c. which occurs later (in a sentence); to bend (a bow); to detract, debase, dishonour: Caus. -कर्षयति, to remove, diminish, detract.
a: अपकृष् — {c1c} P., {c6c} U. 1 (a) To draw back or away, draw off or aside, drag down, drag away, take or carry off, take or draw out, extract; आनायिभिस्तामपकृष्टनक्रां R. 16. 55 drawn out; दंताग्रभिन्नमपकृष्य निरीक्षते च Rs. 4. 14 pulling off or back. (b) To take or carry away, remove; धैर्यं शोकोऽपकर्षति Rām.; किंत्वनुष्ठाननित्यत्वं स्वातंत्र्यमपकर्षति U. 1. 8, Mv. 4. 33 prevents or interferes with freedom of action; क्षात्रंतेजोपकर्षति Mv. 1. 32 destroys, robs one of. --2 To diminish, decrease, omit; अपकर्षेदेवं यावत्पंचदश Suśr. --3 To bend (as a bow); धनुः श्रेष्ठमपकृष्य Mb. --4 To lower or debase, dishonour, detract from, lessen the value of, disparage; पीडयन् भृत्यवर्गं हि आत्मानमपकर्षति Mb. --5 To bring or draw backwards; anticipate (as a word in a sentence) what occurs later on; अग्रिमसूत्रस्थं सर्वत्रग्रहणमिहापकृष्यते P. IV. 1. 17 Com. --Caus. To remove, take away, lessen, diminish, detract from; काव्यस्यात्मभूतं रसमपकर्षयंतः काव्यस्यापकर्षकाः (दोषाः) उच्यंते S. D. 1.

s: strI, (ap + kf + BAve Sa .) drohaH । apakAraH । iti hemacandraH ॥ (viparItaprayogaH । “caturTopAyasADye tu ripO sAntvamapakriyA” । iti mAGaH .)
v: apakriyA
strI apa + kf--mAve striyAM Sa । drohe, apakAre ca । caturTopAyasADye tu ripO sAntvamapakriyeti” mAGaH । “janmavezatapasAM viroDinIM mA kfTAH punaramUmapakriyAmiti” kirA॰ ।
m: अप-क्रिया f. a wrong or improper act
a: अपक्रिया — 1 Hurt, injury, disservice; fault, wrong or faulty deed, misdeed; चतुर्थोपायसाध्ये तु शत्रौ सांत्वमपक्रिया Śi. 2. 54; Ki. 13. 64 fault. --2 Paying or clearing off (debts).

s: puM, (ap + kruS + BAve GaY .) nindanaM । jugupsanaM । BartsanaM । iti SabdaratnAvalI ।
v: apakroSa
pu॰ apa + kruSa--GaY । nindane । upakroSo'pyatra । BAve lyuw । apakroSanamapyatra na॰ ।
a: अपक्रोशः — Abuse, reviling.

v: apakti
strI na paktiH aBAvArTe na॰ ta॰ । pAkABAve ।
a: अपक्तिः — f. 1 Unripeness, immaturity. --2 Indigestion.

m: अप-कुञ्ज m. N. of a younger brother of the serpent-king Śeṣa, Hariv.
अप-कुक्षि m. a bad or ill-shaped belly (?), Pāṇ. vi, 2, 187
(also used as a बहु-व्रीहि and अव्ययी-भाव.)
अपक्वाशिन् mfn. eating raw, uncooked food.

s: tri, (na pacyate, pac + karmmaRi ktaH, tato naYsamAsaH .) pakvaBinnaH । kA~cA iti BAzA । yaTA, -- “tEle viparyyayaM vidyAt pakve cApakva eva ca” । iti vEdyakapariBAzA । tatparyyAyaH । 2 asidDaM । 3 AmaM । 4 asftaM । iti ratnamAlA । (“apakve lavaRaM dadyAt pakve dadyAt marIcakam” ॥ iti AptavAkye .)
v: apakva
tri॰ na pakvaH । apariRate apakvayogI apariRatayogI yaTA yogAByAsa ucitaH taTAByAsaSUnyaH ityarTaH । Ame taRqulaPalAdO ca । “apakvena varttitavyaM PalamUlAdinApi veti” smftiH ।
a: अपक्व — a. Unripe, immature, undigested (as food); uncooked, raw.
अपक्षीण — p. p. Declined, wasted, waned.

v: apakza
tri॰ nAsti pakzo garut yasya । pakzaSUnye uqqayanaSaktiSUnye ca । pakzaH sahAyaH । tacCUnye ।
m: not on the same side or party
a: अपक्ष — a. 1 Without wings or the power of flight. --2 Not belonging to the same side or party. --3 Having no adherents or friends. --4 Opposed to, adverse. --Comp. --पातः impartiality. --पातिन् a. impartial.

v: apakzapAta
pu॰ pakze sahAyatAyAM pAtaH AnukUlyam aBAvArTe na॰ ta॰ । pakzapAtABAve sahAyatA'karaRe । “apakzapAtAt vaktavyaM saBAyAmiti niScaya iti” nIti॰ ।
apakzapAtin
tri॰ pakze sahAyatAyAM patati pata--Rini 70 ta॰ tataH na॰ ta॰ । pakzapAtiminne yaTArTavAdini ।
m: अ-पक्षपातिन् mfn. not flying with wings (and ‘a partisan of A i.e. Viṣṇu’), Vās.
अ-पक्ष—पुच्छ mfn. without wings and tail, ŚBr. &c.
अप-क्षय m. decline, decay, wane, VP.
a: अपक्षयः — Decline, decay, wane.
अपक्षेपः, --क्षेपणं — 1 Casting away or throwing down. --2 Throwing or putting down, one of the 5 kinds of कर्मन् in the Vaiśeṣika phil., see कर्मन्.

v: apakzepaRa

na॰ apa--kzipa--lyuw । aDaHsTAnasaMyogahetO kriyAviSeze, aDaHpAtane ca । avakzepaRamamyatrArTe । utkzepaRaM taTApakzepaRamAkuYcanaM taTA prasAraRaYca gamanaM karmmARyetAni paYca ceti” BAzA॰ avakzepaRamiti vA pAWaH ।

m: अप-√ 4. क्षि Pass. -क्षीयते, to decline, wane (as the moon), TS.; ŚBr.
a: अपक्षि — {c1c} {c5c} {c9c} P. To bring to an end, destroy, annihilate. --pass. To decline, decay, waste away; wane (as the moon).

m: अप-√ क्षिप् to throw away or down, take away, remove.
a: अपक्षिप् — {c6c} P. To throw away or down, take away, remove.

m: अप-क्षिप्त mfn. thrown down or away.
